name: evaluator-form
title: EvaluatorForm
description: Controlled, config-driven builder for a built-in evaluator. Dispatches on value.type (Phoenix's code-evaluator model): a select switches the evaluator type; the fields below edit the config for the current type -- exact_match/contains -> a target string; regex -> pattern + optional flags; levenshtein/json_distance -> a numeric threshold. Switching type emits a fresh config of that type with sensible defaults. Fully controlled (value + onChange); the form only edits -- execution/sandboxing of the evaluator is a platform concern. Composes DS primitives.
